page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at top, with the page number at the top right. No marginal notes; a small dot stands in the left margin beside the line "vinæ,tùm Moralis".

main_text.p: iterandi, per ejectionem ex Paradiso, tùm Protoplastis, tùm etiàm Posteris adempta est, nunc ipsum nobis norma Moralis, etiàm hoc tempore formaliter observanda in actionibus nostris, dici non potest.

3. Benedictio & sanctificatio Sabbathi hebdomadalis tali causa, tali fine facta est; tales etiàm post lapsum manserunt occasiones, atque ampliùs sub Evangelio; ut eadem obligatio, quoad rem ipsam, sic deinceps obtineat. Hinc Præceptum Morale habetur.

4. Circumcisio Abrahamo fideli, patri fidelium, per fidem justificato, verè fuit sacramentum Evangelicum, sigillum justitiæ fidei; quo simul etiàm circumcisio cordis, ad veram gratitudinem, novamque obedientiam, ad normam Legis Divinæ, tùm Moralis, tùm etiàm Cerimonialis (quatenùs hæc etiàm tunc obtinuit) præstandam syncerè & perfectè perfectione partium, ei obsignata fuit. page.notes: A small dot stands in the left margin beside "vinæ,tùm" and a faint mark beside "cordis" and "Cerimonialis"; these are not printed words. Lines "Sabbathi. Cap. IV." are the running head. The word "mate-" at the foot continues on the next page. Some letters are blurred, e.g. "obligatio" and "rem i-psam" (read as "rem ipsam"); "fideles" and "syncerè" read as printed.
